title: Centre Notifies 7th Draft for Ecologically Sensitive Areas (ESA) in Western Ghats
summary: Proposes protection for 56,825 sq. km. across 6 states based on Madhav Gadgil WGEEP report.

blocks.content: Proposes protection for 56,825 sq. km. across 6 states based on Madhav Gadgil WGEEP report.

items: Protected Area: 56,825 sq. km. across Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu (1,500 km length).
Committee Reference: Western Ghats Ecology Expert Panel (WGEEP 2011) headed by Madhav Gadgil.
